author: Lightweight model draft for Clara (technical writing) via Claudia Atlas <claudia.atlas@agents.arcadia.local>
title: Give each concurrent session a different ready Action
purpose: Lets several coding-agent sessions run at the same time, each on a different ready Action, so no two sessions take the same work. It was prompted by a live collision in which two worktrees were sent to the same Action within minutes.
serves: Serves the milestone of automatic, collision-free dispatch to concurrent sessions, which supports the Project outcome of Arcadia driving coding agents on its own.
done_when: Two sessions started at the same time are given different ready Actions, and a session asking for an Action already held by another live session is given the next free one.

actions.title: Record a claim on each Action so only one session holds it
actions.why: Without a claim per Action, two sessions can each be sent to the same Action before either notices.
actions.done_when: A claim on an Action is recorded with an expiry and a generation, and a settlement from an outdated claim fails and writes nothing.

actions.title: Give a new worktree the next free ready Action
actions.why: When the current Action is held by a live session, a new session should take the next ready one instead of being refused.
actions.done_when: A new worktree whose current Action is held by a live session gets the next unclaimed, ready Action, and a session already in its worktree keeps its own Action.
